summary: Variadic formatted-write dispatcher. When the mode flag at this+0x10 is zero, formats and writes directly to a file handle via the locked file write wrapper and returns 0. Otherwise formats into a local buffer, computes the length including terminator, and writes all formatted bytes through the buffer fill wrapper, returning true only when every byte was written.

operations.description: If the mode flag at this+0x10 is zero, take the direct file-write path.
Write the formatted string directly to the file handle with locking and return 0.
Format the variadic arguments into the local 2048-byte buffer safely.
Compute the formatted length plus terminator: strlen(buffer) + 1.
If the content length minus terminator is not positive, return 0.
Write the formatted bytes (length minus terminator) into the buffer sink with timeout.
Return true only if the number of bytes written equals the full formatted length.

unresolved: The exact type and lifecycle of the sink object (file handle vs buffer descriptor) is not derivable from this function alone.
